% An article with biblatex's authoryear style, through the bibtex backend.
% Its bibliography has no labels: the style's list sets \leftmargin to
% \bibhang and \itemindent to -\leftmargin (authoryear.bbx), so each entry
% starts at the margin and its later lines are indented by \bibhang.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[backend=bibtex,style=authoryear]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{test-biblatex-authoryear.bib}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \textcite{book} and \parencite{paper}.
\printbibliography
\end{document}
